title: Conditional deterministic small-space acceptance-probability estimation from hitting sets for wider branching programs
author: Kuan Cheng and William M. Hoza
work: Hitting Sets Give Two-Sided Derandomization of Small Space
source_version: Theory of Computing 18 (2022), Article 21, publisher source publication September 20, 2022; DOI 10.4086/toc.2022.v018a021

source_locator.proof_scope: Complete author argument including supplied core constructions

difficulty_reason: The selected two-sided derandomization builds a wider branching program that verifies a full table of sampled vertex-reachability probabilities, rather than merely searching a hitting set for an accepting input. Its complete author core proves that a source-local consistency test propagates bounded total layer error while accepting a sample table guaranteed by the assumed hitting set. The construction also gives an explicit repeated-read small-space implementation with exact dyadic counters, so its main obstacle is a nonroutine uniform verification-and-estimation reduction rather than routine concentration or a restated L=BPL consequence.
